summary: Three‑hour ingestion‑rate spike (+66 %) starting at 11:40 PST, accompanied by connectivity warnings, suggesting a temporary health‑check or network problem.

impact.description: Temporary overload of ingestion pipelines and downstream back‑pressure risk.

trigger: Kafka producer connection WARN logs (47) and Netty stream WARN logs (3) coinciding with the ingestion‑rate spike.
rootCause: Unconfirmed – likely a transient health‑check or network connectivity issue that caused Kafka producer warnings and a brief ingestion‑rate surge.
contributingFactors: Spike in ingestion‑rate metrics (event and batch accepted) from 11:40‑14:30 PST.
Subsequent decline to ~161 k events/s by 15:02 PST.

timeline.event: Peak ends, rate begins to decline.
Rate at ~161 k events/s (still +10 % above baseline).

recommendedActions: Review recent deployment/Helm revision and health‑check configuration changes.
Inspect pod restarts and OOM events (kubectl get pod -l app_fortidata_name=ingestion-server).
Validate network/DNS connectivity from Consul agents to the health‑check endpoint.
